title: The hypercube Ramsey number has linear order
main_claim: Part 7/8 (§16 low modes: geometry and cell states; §17 initial list gates and resampling). In the low modes, the cell-based fresh sampler with calibrated bins and labels has the singleton and joint upper comparisons it claims. The early-list failure event S_v has conditional probability ≤ n^{-P} on typical pools, except on a pool event of probability n^{-RT_s/2}. Fixed-priority parallel resampling over T_s = ⌈log² n⌉ rounds removes final failures with probability 1 - n^{-PT_s/2}. Its final target states keep a multiplicative (1+o(1)) comparison with independent fresh states.
coverage:
I read the whole block line by line. I checked each step's hypotheses against the cited statements: Cor. deep-discrepancy (9), Lem. homogeneous-peeling, Lem. simultaneous-row-trimming (11), Lem. stable-patch-cleaning (12), eqs (13)-(16) and Prop. balanced-patch-profiles in §14, Lem. finite-low-mode-data, Lem. conditional-avoidance, Lem. near-product-injection (17), and the patch-type parameters in §13 (s_i = 10^{-3}g in direct mode, s_i = (a/10^6)h_i in cluster mode, ℓ_i and log(N/M_i) ≤ s_i/(1000u)).

§16:
- Lem. late-classes-cells: VERIFIED. The (syndrome, parity) map has full rank because the IDs include 0 and all of H_0, and n > H_*/2. Class sizes are 2^{n-1}/H_*. Ordering the classes so every suffix splits evenly gives ≥⌊j/2⌋ late neighbours in any last j classes and p(v) ≥ r/2. At most one late neighbour is internal because internal IDs lie in distinct cosets, and H_*/r ≍ n/log n cosets are available. Slot counts fit among the bins: total slots ≤ (2K/c)·B_i/C_n, using Θ(2^n M_i/N) roles per patch and C_n → ∞. The permutation-vs-iid comparison holds with error exp(polylog)/B_i.
- Permission table (21) and \bar q: VERIFIED. Markov plus (13) gives an e^{-Ω(n)} loss.
- Lem. typical-cell-pools: VERIFIED. Bounded differences gives the normalizers. The 2√ε integral follows from the pretrim and the h³√ε normalization. Slot-replacement sensitivity is n^{-A_c+o(1)} because hkT = o(log n). The load-gate mean is ≤ 12/K_cell, with per-slice contributions n^{-A_c+o(1)}.
- Prop. calibrated-group-bins: VERIFIED in its local-lemma comparison and its centred-price separation and exact-calibration argument; I checked that the gain d^{-.1} beats the 2d^{-2} singleton error. The capacity-certificate step cited from §15 was not re-derived.
- Prop. calibrated-role-labels: VERIFIED. Cluster mode: atoms ≤ d^{-.95} via (13), the pinned-star bound O(dε^{1/8}), and the joint bound with ≤ h_i roles per bin. Direct mode: d = L^slot, column sums ≤ 1/K_cell, and (L^slot)^{.025} = n^{5+o(1)}, which is ≥ n^3.
- Rem. low-fixed-scale: consistent.
- Lem. fresh-singleton (22): VERIFIED. The factor chain is load gate, then pool normalizer, then permission trim, then exact π_i at the fixed point.
- Lem. fresh-internal-prior: VERIFIED. The (L/B)^m containment cancels the restriction factors, and the pretrim and joint-comparison costs are bounded.

§17:
- Lem. independent-pinned-list: VERIFIED. I recomputed Γ ≤ K e^{-200 s_i} 2^{-p(v)} in all three modes:
  - cluster: the edge count d+h ≤ n-p+1-s-c' cancels 2^h, and 2^s·4^{c'}·2^{-s-c'} ≤ e^{s/(1000u)};
  - direct: the e^{-g/2} gain beats e^{g^{a_B}+g/1000} and leaves e^{-g/5};
  - bounded: holds with fixed K.
  The hypotheses of the centred-moment lemma hold because O(log n/n) ≤ b_* and τ has small width. Also checked: 0.8·3/4 > 1/2, and the support bound E|L_v(J)| ≤ exp(O(log⁴ n)) together with a union over exp(O(log⁵ n)) sets J.
- Lem. uniform-pool-list-estimate: VERIFIED. This covers the A_v construction in all three pin cases, the conversion of (22) to slot-index weights, the overlap-rank count with ≤2j pinned occurrences, the per-occurrence weight ≤ 11 (= B_i·d_i·11/M_i), and the step that splits off the own-tape compatibility check. The bracket tends to 0 because L = n^{200} and 2R/s_0 ≤ .1. The final bound n^{-(R-P)T_s} ≤ n^{-RT_s/2} holds since R = P² with P > 2.
- Lem. low-mode-palettes: VERIFIED. The linear code gives χ ≤ 4·Vol ≤ e^{s_i}. The atom cap gives a Chernoff exponent C_n e^{199s}2^{p}, which beats n^{2+o(1)} histories. Ratio identity for R_j checked. Bulk and crossing typical factors are bounded. Exceptions are handled by the relaxed row tails, and passing from the uniform law to σ_v costs ≤ 2^h. The uniform 2d-power integral checked.
- Prop. initial-resampling-comparison: VERIFIED. Influence spreads at most 2 graph steps per round, so radius 2T_s+3 suffices. The component argument gives ≥ T_s executions. The maximal-independent extra sites give a 3-step connected witness. Tape entries are distinct and independent across tests. The backward-closure counting is correct, and the terminal entries are independent of the necessary tests, which gives the (1+o(1)) multiplicative comparison.
- Rem. resampling-test-scope: consistent.

Not independently re-derived: the cited lemmas themselves (moderate-interaction moment, capacity certificates in §15, near-product injection internals). I only checked that their hypotheses hold where they are used.
sibling_notes:
Several things are proved elsewhere and should be checked by other parts:
- The union bound needed to apply (23) to all events in a radius-(2T_s+3) ball requires R/2 > 2(A_c+4) roughly. That is plausible with R = P² and P large, but it is used in §18, outside this block.
- The capacity-certificate machinery (§15, sec:bin-and-injection-stages) and Lem. moderate-interaction-moment are relied on but not audited here.
- C_n → ∞ is needed so that all cells' slots fit disjointly among the B_i bins (§16 lines 105-108). It should be established in the reduction (§2).
